title: fix(types,core,plugin-list,plugin-view,app-shell): derive ViewType from @objectstack/spec instead of re-declaring it
body:
Fixes #8127

## What this changes

`ViewType` and its zod face `ViewTypeSchema` stop being hand-written copies of
`@objectstack/spec`'s list-view type vocabulary and become derivations of it. Every
structure keyed on them follows from that, so the exhaustiveness guarantee they were
supposed to provide is real again rather than total-over-a-copy.

Per the triage ruling on the card, this is the derivation route — `page` is **not**
hand-added to an eleven-arm literal.

## The measurement that decided the design

The spec models **two** unions here, and conflating them is what makes this look like
"add `page` in twelve places" when it is not:

| spec symbol | members | what it means |
|---|---|---|
| `ListViewSchema.shape.type` | 10, **with** `page` | every list-view type |
| `VisualizationTypeSchema` | 9, **without** `page` | what a user can switch between — the union `AppearanceConfig.allowedVisualizations` is typed on |

The spec's own docblock on the expanded list-view schema says why: it carries
"the `type: 'page'` ⇄ `pageName` binding check". A `type: 'page'` view **mounts a
published page in place of rows**; it is not a visualization that draws records.

⇒ `ViewType` must gain `page`. Structures that enumerate what a renderer **draws**
must not — and now cannot, because they derive from the subtraction rather than
restate a list.

## The sharpest statement of the bug, measured on `5505aec`

`@object-ui/types`' **published validator already accepted** `viewType: 'page'` — its
`ViewKindEnum` (`zod/objectql.zod.ts`) was derived from the spec all along:

```
viewType:page accepted by objectui ListViewSchema? true
parsed viewType = "page" | pageName = "welcome"
control (viewType:nonsense) accepted? false
```

while the renderer resolved it to **exactly what it resolved a typo to**:

```
specType=page               -> viewType="grid"
specType=kanban             -> viewType="kanban"
specType=gallery            -> viewType="gallery"
specType=nonsense-control   -> viewType="grid"
```

That is `declared !== enforced` on a published surface: the validator says yes, the
renderer silently draws something else, and a spec-valid view is byte-indistinguishable
from a misspelling. The derivation mechanism already existed in this repo — it had just
never been applied to the two faces the card names.

## The promise is true again — ablation

`LIST_VIEW_KINDS`' docblock promises "a kind added to the union fails the build **HERE**".
Adding a synthetic member to the derived union, rebuilding `@object-ui/types` so it
reaches `dist`, then type-checking `@object-ui/core`:

```
=== marker count BEFORE mutation: 0
=== marker count AFTER mutation:  1
53:export type ViewType = NonNullable< SpecListView['type']> | 'sunburst' | 'list' | 'detail';
types build exit=0
=== marker present in dist? 1
MUTATION_LEG_EXIT=2
src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts(168,7): error TS2741: Property 'sunburst' is missing in type
'{ grid: true; kanban: true; ... tree: true; }' but required in type 'Record< ListViewVisualization, true>'.
restore: git diff HEAD is EMPTY
```

Restore leg: source clean, `MARKER_IN_DIST=0`, `@object-ui/core` type-check exit 0.

## Build-failing vs merely `page`-carrying — the honest split

The card names five lists with no type comparison at all. Four of the five are now
**build-failing**; none of them merely gained a word.

| site | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `core/utils/normalize-list-view.ts` `LIST_VIEW_KINDS` | total over the stale copy | **build-failing** on `ListViewVisualization`; new `UNDRAWABLE_VIEW_KINDS` makes the other half of the union total too |
| `plugin-list/ViewSwitcher.tsx` `ViewType` + its 2 maps | a **third** local re-declaration | **build-failing** — alias of `ListViewVisualization` |
| `plugin-list/index.tsx` SDUI enum ×2 | two 7-entry literals | **build-failing** — one total `Record`; both had drifted, missing `chart` and `tree` |
| `plugin-list/ListView.tsx` allowlist | 9-name literal array | **derived** — calls `isListViewVisualization`, the map's own predicate |
| `app-shell/CreateViewDialog.tsx` picker | `type: string`, never compared | **build-failing** — total `Record` |
| `types/designer.ts` `UnifiedViewType` | 8-arm literal, had drifted | **derived** from spec `VisualizationType` (gains `tree`) |
| `plugin-view` `DEFAULT_VIEW_LABELS` / `DEFAULT_VIEW_ICONS` / `iconMap` | total over the stale copy | keyed on the full `ViewType`, so these **do** carry `page` — they label any view type that exists |

## The silence is closed, the renderer is not widened

⛔ This PR does **not** add a page renderer — that is a feature, not this card. A
`type: 'page'` view still falls back to a grid. What changes is that it says so once,
using this repo's existing loud-fail-open convention (`core/evaluator/fieldRules.ts`,
objectstack#5149), so a spec-valid view no longer degrades identically to a typo.

## i18n: ten locale packs, zero new keys — and why

Triage priced this as "⚠️ i18n 是硬工作量:十个语言包,每个要一个 label 和一个 description".
**Measured, that work is not owed.** Every locale-backed view-type label belongs to a
*visualization* picker or switcher, and `page` is correctly absent from those by
construction. `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` and `check:i18n-dead-keys` are all
green with no locale file touched.

⚠️ One real trap found on the way: building the bundle keys from a stem
(`t(...viewType${stem}...)`) type-checks fine and turns ten packs' worth of coverage into
a prefix check. `check:i18n-keys` caught it (`[undeclared-dynamic-family]`). The keys are
back to literals inside the total record — totality from the `Record`, checkability from
the literals.

## 验收备注

- **The card's site list is incomplete, and its line numbers are off this tree.** Re-taken
  on `5505aec`: `zod/views.zod.ts` is line **26** (card/comment said 25); the `ListView.tsx`
  allowlist is **2241** (card said 2224); the SDUI enums carry **7** entries each, not the
  nine the card states.
- **A third local re-declaration the card does not mention**: `plugin-list/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx`
  declared and **exported** its own nine-arm `ViewType`. The card describes that file's two
  maps as total over the shared union; they were total over this private copy. One level
  deeper than filed.
- **A fourth, in a pin test.** `plugin-view/src/__tests__/ViewSwitcher.test.tsx` carried
  `const ALL_VIEW_TYPES: ViewType[] = [...]` under the comment "adding a member to the union
  without extending this list is a compile error here too". **That claim was false** — a short
  array is assignable to an array type; the annotation rejects an invalid member and says
  nothing about a missing one. It compiled green at eleven entries and only the runtime
  `toEqual` went red. Now `satisfies Record< ViewType, true>`, which actually delivers it.
- **A second hardcoded allowlist at `ListView.tsx:2293` was deliberately left alone** — it sits
  inside a commented-out `useEffect` ("DISABLED: interfering with schema-defined views"). Dead
  code, not a site.
- **Triage's "third instance of the class" question is unresolved here, not answered.** The two
  earlier instances (the capability set, `ObjectFieldGroup.visibleWhen`) could not be confirmed
  as local re-declarations from this checkout: it is shallow and both fixes are outside the log
  window. ⛔ Not guessed. What this PR *does* establish is that the pattern is at least
  **four** re-declarations of this one vocabulary, two of which nobody had filed.
- **Out of scope, not filed** — same family, different concept (`defaultViewType` / designer
  variant lists), all outside the declared file surface and none of them the `page` defect:
  `types/objectql.ts:1804` and `:1988`, `types/zod/objectql.zod.ts:258`, `plugin-view/index.tsx:76`,
  `app-shell/.../anchors.ts:269`, `app-shell/.../ViewVariantInspector.tsx:191`.

## Review

⚠️ Clause-② — this widens the accept set. `needs:contract-review` is on the card and on
this PR; ⛔ neither carrier cleared by me. Staying **draft**, not enqueued, auto-merge not armed.
